args.command: set -euo pipefail; sed -i 's#state_dir = "~/.openchatx-mcp"#state_dir = "./.openchatx-state"#' .openchatx/config.toml; mkdir -p .openchatx-state; echo '===CONFIG==='; cat .openchatx/config.toml; echo '===START==='; /opt/node/bin/node dist/index.js > /tmp/openchatx-linux-smoke3.log 2>&1 &; pid=$!; trap 'kill $pid 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT; sleep 5; echo '===PROCESS==='; ps -o pid,ppid,stat,etime,%cpu,%mem,args -p $pid; echo '===PORT==='; ss -ltnp | grep ':8001 ' || true; echo '===HTTP_ROOT==='; curl -sS -o /tmp/openchatx-root.out -w 'HTTP %{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8001/ || true; head -c 300 /tmp/openchatx-root.out || true; echo; echo '===MCP_INIT==='; curl -sS -i -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8001/mcp -H 'content-type: application/json' -H 'accept: application/json, text/event-stream' --data-binary '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-06-18","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"zen-linux-probe","version":"1"}}}' | sed -n '1,40p' || true; echo '===LOG==='; cat /tmp/openchatx-linux-smoke3.log
